purpose: Seek a counterexample to endpoint-only branching with t>=2 beyond the complete n<=5 discovery corpus.
timing_projection: n=5 measured 0.22066 s / 11025 pairs; per-pair scaling by Bell(6)/Bell(5)=203/52 projects about 0.156 s for 2000 pairs, plus fresh tree caches and output. Distribution and overhead differ: measure directly, do not claim the projection as a bound.
acceptance: Exact counterexamples only; sample survival is not a universal proof and these discovery values cannot certify a candidate selected against them.
